---
title: "Australian NOM Nowcast"
subtitle: "Real-time estimate of quarterly Net Overseas Migration"
date: today
date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
files <- list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
for (f in files) sys.source(f, envir = globalenv())
library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(gt); library(scales); library(lubridate)

cfg   <- config::get(file = "config.yml")
asof  <- Sys.Date()

# All-in-one site build: fetch + fit. Targets cache is reused when
# available so this should be cheap on repeat renders.
panel <- tryCatch(targets::tar_read(panel_quarterly), error = function(e) NULL)
if (is.null(panel) || !nrow(panel)) {
  oad <- fetch_oad(cfg, asof); nom <- fetch_nom(cfg, asof); vg <- fetch_visa_grants(cfg, asof)
  panel <- build_quarterly_panel(clean_oad(oad, cfg), clean_nom(nom, cfg),
                                 clean_visa_grants(vg, cfg), cfg)
}
fit_multi <- fit_kalman_multi(panel, cfg)
fc_multi  <- forecast_kalman_multi(fit_multi, asof, cfg)
fits_uni  <- fit_kalman_univariate(panel, cfg)
fc_uni    <- forecast_kalman_univariate(fits_uni, asof, cfg)
pi_emp    <- estimate_pi_empirical(panel, cfg)
pi_sm     <- smooth_pi(pi_emp, cfg)

kalman_headline <- build_nowcast_headline_from_multi(fc_multi, cfg)

# Prefer the Bayesian Kalman headline (models.headline_model) when a snapshot is
# committed (regenerated weekly by the `Refresh headline (Bayes)`
# workflow or locally via scripts/refresh_headline_bayes.R). Falls back
# to the Kalman headline when no snapshot is present so the render
# workflow stays Stan-free.
bayes_snapshot_path <- "data/headline_bayes.rds"
bayes_meta_path     <- "data/headline_bayes_meta.rds"
has_bayes_headline <- file.exists(bayes_snapshot_path)
bayes_headline_meta <- if (file.exists(bayes_meta_path)) readRDS(bayes_meta_path) else NULL

headline <- if (has_bayes_headline) {
  readRDS(bayes_snapshot_path) |>
    dplyr::select("period", "nom_mean", "nom_se",
                  "lower_80", "upper_80", "lower_95", "upper_95")
} else kalman_headline

headline_model_short <- if (has_bayes_headline) {
  bayes_headline_meta$model %||% "bayes_kalman"
} else "kalman_multi_v2"
headline_model_label <- switch(headline_model_short,
  bayes_kalman_seasonal = "seasonal Bayesian state-space model (Phase 3 v1.0, `bayes_kalman_seasonal`) with Kalman-filter likelihood",
  bayes_kalman          = "Bayesian state-space model (Phase 3 v0.6, `bayes_kalman`) with Kalman-filter likelihood",
  "multivariate state-space Kalman filter (Phase 2 v4.0)")
# The number on the card comes from the committed snapshot, which can be
# up to a week older than the page render. Show the fit date honestly.
headline_fit_date <- if (has_bayes_headline && !is.null(bayes_headline_meta$asof)) {
  as.Date(bayes_headline_meta$asof)
} else asof

# Identify the current quarter and the most recent ABS-published quarter
asof_q  <- nn_quarter_start(asof - lubridate::days(1L))
abs_obs <- panel |>
  dplyr::filter(category == "total", !is.na(nom_final)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(period)
latest_abs <- if (nrow(abs_obs)) tail(abs_obs, 1L) else NULL

# Pick the headline row: the latest forecast quarter for which ABS hasn't yet
# published a number.
hl_row <- headline |>
  dplyr::filter(period > (if (!is.null(latest_abs)) latest_abs$period else as.Date("1900-01-01"))) |>
  dplyr::arrange(period) |>
  dplyr::slice(1L)

fmt_k <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return("—")
  paste0(scales::number(x / 1000, accuracy = 0.1), "k")
}
```

::: {.callout-card}
::: {.headline-label}
Headline nowcast — `{r} nn_quarter_label(hl_row$period, sep = ' · ')`
:::
::: {.headline-number}
`{r} fmt_k(hl_row$nom_mean)`
:::
::: {.headline-interval}
80% interval: `{r} fmt_k(hl_row$lower_80)` to `{r} fmt_k(hl_row$upper_80)`
:::
::: {.headline-asof}
Quarterly Net Overseas Migration. Model fit as of `{r} format(headline_fit_date, '%d %B %Y')`; page rendered `{r} format(asof, '%d %B %Y')`.
:::
:::

## What this is

This site publishes a real-time estimate of Australian quarterly **Net
Overseas Migration (NOM)** built from publicly available data only — Overseas
Arrivals and Departures and quarterly population components from the ABS, and
Department of Home Affairs visa-grant statistics via data.gov.au.

The headline number above is the model's nowcast for the quarter ABS hasn't
yet published. The model is a `{r} headline_model_label` — see
[Methodology](methodology.qmd) for the equations and
[Backtest](backtest.qmd) for honest performance numbers.

## Recent quarters

```{r recent-table}
recent <- headline |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    panel |> dplyr::filter(category == "total") |>
      dplyr::select(period, abs_nom = nom_final),
    by = "period"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(period) |>
  dplyr::filter(period >= asof_q %m-% months(15L)) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Quarter      = nn_quarter_label(period, sep = " · "),
    Model        = nom_mean,
    `80% lower`  = lower_80,
    `80% upper`  = upper_80,
    ABS          = abs_nom,
    `Error vs ABS` = ifelse(is.na(abs_nom), NA, nom_mean - abs_nom)
  )

recent |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c("Model", "80% lower", "80% upper", "ABS"),
                 decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = "Error vs ABS",
                 decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE, force_sign = TRUE) |>
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "—") |>
  gt::tab_style(style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
                locations = gt::cells_body(rows = is.na(recent$ABS))) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "small") |>
  gt::tab_source_note(gt::md(paste0(
    "**Model**: ", headline_model_label,
    " — NOM, OAD long-term arrivals and DHA visa grants as joint observations on one latent state. ",
    "**ABS**: latest published NOM via `national-state-and-territory-population` cat. 3101.0. ",
    "Bolded rows are unpublished by ABS at the render date — those are nowcasts. ",
    "Rows ABS has since published show the model's *smoothed* value at fit time, not the real-time nowcast; see the Backtest page for honest real-time errors."
  )))
```

## Where the model gets its signal

The state-space Kalman jointly observes three series, all loading on a shared
latent log-arrivals state:

1. **OAD long-term arrivals** (monthly, 5-week publication lag) — the
   primary high-frequency signal.
2. **DHA visa grants** (annual financial-year aggregates broadcast to
   quarters via OAD proportions) — a *leading* indicator: visa grants in
   FY-Y predict arrivals in FY-Y and FY-Y+1.
3. **ABS quarterly NOM total** (~6 month publication lag) — direct
   observation of the target itself, used to anchor the latent state for
   historical quarters.

When ABS hasn't yet published NOM for the current quarter, the model uses
OAD and visa-grants observations to estimate the latent state, then maps
back to NOM via a calibrated offset. See [Methodology](methodology.qmd) for
the equations.

## How accurate is it?

```{r accuracy-table}
#| results: asis
scored_path <- "data/backtest_scored.rds"
bt_meta     <- if (file.exists("data/backtest_meta.rds")) readRDS("data/backtest_meta.rds") else NULL
scored <- if (file.exists(scored_path)) readRDS(scored_path) else NULL
acc_model <- if (!is.null(scored) && headline_model_short %in% scored$model) {
  headline_model_short
} else if (!is.null(scored) && "kalman_multi_v2" %in% scored$model) "kalman_multi_v2" else NULL
if (!is.null(acc_model)) {
  acc <- scored |>
    dplyr::filter(model == acc_model, category == "total", regime == "post_covid") |>
    dplyr::group_by(horizon) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), RMSE = mean(rmse, na.rm = TRUE),
                     Bias = mean(bias, na.rm = TRUE), Cov80 = mean(cov80, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(horizon) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Horizon = dplyr::case_when(
      horizon < 0 ~ sprintf("h = %d (backcast)", horizon),
      horizon == 0 ~ "h = 0 (nowcast)",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("h = +%d (forecast)", horizon)))
  cat(sprintf("Post-COVID out-of-sample backtest of `%s` across %s quarterly as-of dates (refreshed %s), each restricted to what was publicly observable at the time:\n\n",
              acc_model,
              if (!is.null(bt_meta)) bt_meta$n_successful else "the available",
              if (!is.null(bt_meta)) format(as.Date(bt_meta$refreshed_at), "%d %B %Y") else "—"))
  print(acc |>
    dplyr::select(Horizon, n, RMSE, Bias, Cov80) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::fmt_number(columns = c("RMSE", "Bias"), decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) |>
    gt::fmt_percent(columns = "Cov80", decimals = 0) |>
    gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "—") |>
    gt::cols_label(Cov80 = "80% coverage") |>
    gt::tab_options(table.font.size = "small"))
} else {
  cat("No backtest snapshot is committed yet; see the [Backtest](backtest.qmd) page.\n")
}
```

For context, ABS quarterly NOM is typically 50,000 – 150,000 per quarter.
The model performs best on **backcasts** (revising NOM history), where ABS
NOM is already observed and pins the state down. Nowcasts (the most recent
completed quarter) have wider uncertainty because the model has no direct
NOM signal yet. Full breakdown, including every benchmark and the
calibration check, on the [Backtest](backtest.qmd) page.

## Run details

```{r run-meta}
n_obs <- nrow(panel)
periods_span <- range(panel$period, na.rm = TRUE)
gl_w <- fit_multi$visa_gamma_weights

cat(sprintf("- Page rendered:       %s\n", format(Sys.time(), "%d %B %Y, %H:%M %Z")))
cat(sprintf("- Panel coverage:      %s to %s (%d quarterly observations × %d categories)\n",
            nn_quarter_label(periods_span[1L], sep = "-"),
            nn_quarter_label(periods_span[2L], sep = "-"),
            length(unique(panel$period)), length(unique(panel$category))))
oad_edge <- panel |> dplyr::filter(category == "total", !is.na(oad_lt_arrivals)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(period) |> utils::tail(1L)
if (nrow(oad_edge)) {
  cat(sprintf("- Latest OAD quarter:  %s (%s of 3 months published; partial quarters are %s)\n",
              nn_quarter_label(oad_edge$period, sep = "-"),
              ifelse(is.na(oad_edge$oad_months), "?", oad_edge$oad_months),
              switch(cfg$panel$oad_partial_quarter %||% "scale",
                     scale = "grossed up by historical month shares",
                     drop  = "treated as missing",
                     raw   = "summed as-is (legacy)")))
}
cat(sprintf("- Headline model:      %s\n",
            if (has_bayes_headline) paste0(headline_model_short, " (HMC)") else
              fit_multi$kind %||% "kalman_multi"))
if (has_bayes_headline && !is.null(bayes_headline_meta)) {
  cat(sprintf("- Bayes snapshot:      fit as of %s, refreshed %s (fit took %.1fs)\n",
              format(as.Date(bayes_headline_meta$asof), "%d %B %Y"),
              format(bayes_headline_meta$refreshed_at, "%d %B %Y %H:%M %Z"),
              bayes_headline_meta$elapsed_seconds))
}
cat(sprintf("- Alpha_v offset:      %.3f (log-gap OAD-arrivals vs lagged visa-grants)\n",
            fit_multi$alpha_v))
cat(sprintf("- Alpha_n offset:      %.3f (log-gap OAD-arrivals vs NOM)\n",
            fit_multi$alpha_n))
if (!is.null(gl_w)) {
  cat("- Kalman gamma weights: ", paste(round(gl_w, 3), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```
